people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Gad
people.line: Israelite tribe; descended from Gad, son of Jacob.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Of the children of Ammon. Yahweh says: “Has Israel no sons? Has he no heir? Why then does Malcam possess Gad, and his people dwell in its cities?
translations.bsb: Concerning the Ammonites, this is what the LORD says: “Has Israel no sons? Is he without heir? Why then has Milcom taken possession of Gad? Why have his people settled in their cities?
translations.kjv: Concerning the Ammonites, thus saith the LORD; Hath Israel no sons? hath he no heir? why then doth their king inherit Gad, and his people dwell in his cities?
translations.asv: Of the children of Ammon. Thus saith Jehovah: Hath Israel no sons? hath he no heir? why then doth Malcam possess Gad, and his people well in the cities thereof?
